title: A redline of a 2x screenshot reads in points, with dimension lines that show what each number spans
goal: This finishes what the user asked for in the calm redline and did not get: a redline of a Retina screenshot should say its numbers in points ("124 pt" for a button 248 pixels wide), and every dimension line should start and stop on the edges it measures. Today the numbers say px, and several brackets (under Save Changes, beside the folder field) wander off what they measure, so a reader cannot tell what a number spans.
notes: Carried over from measuring-a-ui-gives-a-calm-redline-each-kind-of (2026-10-20), which shipped code-chosen marks and clear readout placement (Sources/PhotonzCore/Redline.swift, find_measurements / mark_measurements) and took the settings case from 32.5 to 59.0 for Ask (judge 2.8 to 4.8). What the judge still says, verbatim, from Scripts/ask-eval.sh run --engine ask --cases settings-measurements (runs 20261021-044351-ask, 20261021-044837-ask, 20261021-050243-ask or the latest): "values don't match what they point at (124 px on a roughly 250 px button, 18 px on a gap that is clearly larger)"; "there are no end ticks to show what is being measured"; "the brackets don't clearly mark what they measure (26 px, 30 px, 17 px)". The 124 is right in points (MeasureUnit.points, logical px) but labelled px: MeasureUnit.suffix is "px" for both units by design (Measure.swift line 12). Only three call sites use the suffix (Measure.swift label/chipText, MeasureSizeGroup.swift:176, DocumentUnit.swift:27) but about 46 test files and 38 walks expect px readouts, which is why it did not fit in the redline task. Size brackets are MeasureSizeGroup + caliper extension lines (MeasurePlan.swift, MeasureRasterizer.swift).
acceptance: On a 2x screenshot every measurement readout and the Measurements list say pt unless the person chose pixels (the user's calm-redline checklist, 2026-10-20), and every walk and test that expected px on a 2x picture changes in the same commit

Before and after crops of the calm redline on Tests/PhotonzRenderTests/Fixtures/settings-pane-2x.png, from the app's own render: in the after, every dimension line starts and stops on the two edges it measures (end ticks or the Measure tool's equivalent), and no bracket runs along an edge it does not measure

The settings measurements case scores 8 or more on clean and aligned for Ask and for the skill (Scripts/ask-eval.sh run --cases settings-measurements); it scored 4 on clean when the calm redline shipped
Measurements a person places by hand get the same units and the same clearer ends, and every walk that photographs a measurement still passes

Built: (1) MeasureUnit.suffix(pixelScale:) says pt for points on a scaled picture, px otherwise; chips, Measurements rows, size group values, spec list header ('720 × 480 pt @2x') and the inspector follow; unit choice renamed Points/Pixels (MeasureUnit.title). DocumentUnit stays px for layer lengths; strays(in:measuringIn:) lets a measurement's pt through the one-word check. 47 test lines and 7 walks moved from px to pt on 2x pictures (label-size-walk reads a font size and keeps px). (2) MeasureContent.endTicks: a caliper drawn on its own feet (|headOffset| < 8) draws a tick across each end, in MeasureRasterizer and SVGExport; the layer frame and subjectCrossReach include them. (3) Redline only: labelHidesItsLine forbids an on-line number that leaves under 8 px of line each side; a short span's bracket hugs its box at 14 px (RedlineLayout.State.side) with its number just past the head at no rank cost; other brackets' legs and heads now count as lines a readout stays off (RedlineLayout.inked). Tried edge weight 3x: moved the 220 number into the other card, reverted.
